user.title: Connect to free@home SysAP (Local API)
user.description: Enter the SysAP IP/hostname and your Local API credentials (enabled in free@home Settings -> Local API, firmware >= 2.6.0).

data.switch_as_x: Expose switch actuators as switches (instead of lights)
data.include_orphan_channels: Include channels not assigned to a room

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the System Access Point, optionally with a port.
data_description.username: Local API user, shown in the free@home app under Settings > Local API.
data_description.password: Password of the Local API user.
data_description.switch_as_x: Show switch actuators as switch entities. Turn this off to show them as lights.
data_description.name_prefix: Text put in front of every entity name, for example "Local ", to tell the entities apart from those of another integration for the same system.
data_description.use_https: Connect over HTTPS and WSS instead of HTTP and WS.
data_description.verify_ssl: Check the SysAP certificate. Turn this off for the self-signed certificate most SysAPs use.
data_description.include_orphan_channels: Also create entities for channels that have no room in free@home.

dump_config.name: Dump configuration
dump_config.description: Export the full free@home Local API JSON configuration to the Home Assistant config folder.

config_entry_id.name: SysAP
config_entry_id.description: The free@home Local SysAP to use. Required when more than one SysAP is set up and the action writes to it.

monitor.name: Monitor WebSocket frames
monitor.description: Record raw WebSocket JSON frames from the Local API into a JSONL file in the Home Assistant config folder.

config_entry_id.name: SysAP
config_entry_id.description: The free@home Local SysAP to use. Required when more than one SysAP is set up and the action writes to it.

set_datapoint.name: Set datapoint
set_datapoint.description: Write a raw datapoint value to the SysAP Local REST API (e.g. for virtual device feedback).

serialnumber.name: Serial number
serialnumber.description: Device serial number or virtual device serial (e.g. 6000A1B2C3D4).

datapoint_id.name: Datapoint ID
datapoint_id.description: Input or output datapoint identifier (e.g. idp0000 or odp0000).

value.name: Value
value.description: String value to write to the datapoint.

sysap_uuid.name: SysAP UUID
sysap_uuid.description: Optional SysAP UUID (defaults to primary SysAP UUID).

config_entry_id.name: SysAP
config_entry_id.description: The free@home Local SysAP to use. Required when more than one SysAP is set up and the action writes to it.

register_virtual_device.name: Register virtual device
register_virtual_device.description: Register or refresh a virtual/proxy device on the SysAP with optional automatic TTL heartbeat renewal.

native_id.name: Native ID
native_id.description: Unique identifier supplied by your automation for the virtual device.

ttl.name: TTL (seconds)
ttl.description: Time-to-live in seconds (0 = mark unresponsive, -1 = persistent, >0 = periodic keep-alive).

capabilities.name: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Optional capability list (for EnergyMeterv2 or MediaPlayer).

config_entry_id.name: SysAP
config_entry_id.description: The free@home Local SysAP to use. Required when more than one SysAP is set up and the action writes to it.

unregister_virtual_device.name: Unregister virtual device
unregister_virtual_device.description: Stop the TTL heartbeat and mark a persisted virtual device unresponsive (ttl=0) on the SysAP.

native_id.name: Native ID
native_id.description: Unique identifier of the virtual device to unregister.

config_entry_id.name: SysAP

trigger_proxy_device.name: Trigger proxy device action
trigger_proxy_device.description: Trigger an action (shortpress, longpress, release) on a free@home proxy device.

send_notification.name: Send SysAP notification
send_notification.description: Push a notification message to the free@home SysAP (displayed in the app/panels).

config_entry_id.description: The free@home Local SysAP to use. Required when more than one SysAP is set up and the action writes to it.

migrate_from_legacy.name: Take over from freeathome
migrate_from_legacy.description: Preview or take over device names, areas, entity settings, voice assistant settings and history from the freeathome integration.

dry_run.name: Preview only (dry run)
dry_run.description: Inspect the exact migration plan without modifying entries, devices, or entities.

cutover.name: Take over (remove the freeathome entry, keep entity IDs and history)
cutover.description: When off, only settings are copied and both integrations keep running. When on (with dry_run off), the freeathome entry is removed and the free@home Local entities take over its entity IDs and history.

serialnumbers.name: Serial numbers filter (optional)
serialnumbers.description: Optional comma- or newline-separated device serial numbers for selective preview or metadata sync.

config_entry_id.description: The free@home Local SysAP to use. Required when more than one SysAP is set up and the action writes to it.

entry_not_loaded.message: The free@home Local config entry {entry_id} is not loaded.

multiple_entries_loaded.message: More than one SysAP is loaded. Select the config entry to use.

auth_failed.message: The SysAP at {host} rejected the credentials.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the SysAP at {host}: {error}

action_failed.message: The SysAP did not accept the command for {entity_id}: {error}

partial_cutover_not_supported.message: A takeover cannot be limited to serial numbers, because the freeathome integration uses one config entry for the whole SysAP. Use cutover: false for a selective sync, or remove the serial numbers for a full takeover.

legacy_entry_ambiguous.message: Several freeathome config entries exist and none matches this SysAP by serial number or host.

request_failed.message: The SysAP at {host} did not accept the request: {error}
